name: Noda Yuuki
source:
Because of his soft personality, he's the type that the girls from senior classes like to dote on. But he wishes that he was treated in a more manly way. Incidentally, his sense in art is very unique.

[SPOILER]Unfortunately, the moment he finally worked up the courage to refuse someone, he met the end of his life. Truly a sad story. If he had been born in a different era, he may have become a famous artist.[/SPOILER]

[Based on his unlockable character profile.]
